only_admitted_corrective_train_pool.label_role: TRAIN terminal supervision only; not an inference input
only_admitted_corrective_train_pool.selection_method: Apply unchanged fast_selection eligibility against reference 1: accepted, delta>reference_delta, score>reference_score+0.01. Among eligible candidates within 0.01 of their top score choose highest official value. Current 0 is 0.011076 below 3, so only 3 is in the near-top set. If both stay eligible, merely entering the near-top set does not select 0 because official_value[3]>official_value[0].
only_admitted_corrective_train_pool.failure: Successful candidate 0 beat the frozen reference 1 but still lost to accepted failed competitor 3.

feature_geometry.deployment_geometry_condition: This target is sufficient in general. For this pool it is also the score-gap condition to exclude competitor 3 from the near-top set IF both 0 and 3 remain eligible, because value[3]>value[0]. It is not a universal necessary weight norm for every possible deployment correction: another weight direction could instead render competitor 3 ineligible. No such modified policy is fitted, selected or deployed in this audit.

computed_method.candidate_pair_source: The sole admitted corrective TRAIN pool; val labels not accessed.
computed_method.circle_scan: Let A=[z0;z3]. SVD provides its two orthonormal row-space directions. Evaluate 200001 evenly spaced angles at the unchanged final weight norm. Record max 0.05*(tanh(Aw)[0]-tanh(Aw)[1]); no model record is produced or used.
computed_method.lipschitz_bound: Since tanh is 1-Lipschitz, abs(pair correction)<=0.05*norm(w)*norm(z0-z3). This upper bound at the existing norm is below the required switching correction.
computed_method.minimum_norm_geometry: For specified tanh difference t, let q=tanh(u0), u3=atanh(q-t), u0=atanh(q). Scan 400001 q values in (t-1,1), then 80 scalar golden-section refinements about the minimum. Minimum squared linear weight norm for these two logits is u^T*(A*A^T)^(-1)*u. Deployment t refers to the conditional score-gap target while both candidates remain eligible; training t refers to the actual fixed all-competitor 0.02 target. These are numerical geometry estimates, not refitted weights, deployed policy candidates, validation calibration or claims of a new successful selection.
computed_method.penalty: 0.1/2*norm(w)^2, using the unchanged recorded L2 coefficient.
computed_method.limitation: This diagnoses current aggregated 20-dimensional linear+tanh representation. It does not prove every richer representation or every possible global policy is incapable of correcting the pool. The circle scan is a numerical estimate; the separate Lipschitz inequality supplies the norm-bound check.

final_weight_gradient_diagnosis.computed_method: Read-only reconstruction at the saved final weights. For each admitted pair compute gap=base_i-base_j+0.05*(tanh(zi*w)-tanh(zj*w)); derivative=0.05/m*((1-ti^2)*zi-(1-tj^2)*zj). Corrective gradient is mean(-sigmoid(-(gap-2m)/m)*derivative). Protective violation is max(0,(-m-gap)/m), with gradient mean(-2*violation*derivative). L2 gradient is 0.1*w. Reconstruct original TRAIN protective pairs from cloud raw terminal outcome records, restricted to the exact 144 TRAIN keys; use terminal outcomes only to identify TRAIN supervision, never as scoring inputs. No parameter updates are performed.
final_weight_gradient_diagnosis.interpretation: At the saved final weights, successful protection and cost competition are not the main observed obstruction: protection hinges are inactive, no updates were blocked, and cost optimization never ran. Nearly opposing corrective and L2 gradients support a regularized compromise given near-collinear features.
final_weight_gradient_diagnosis.limitation: The final gradient snapshot alone does not prove protective pairs had no influence earlier in optimization.

ordinary_vs_learned_content.decomposition_space: Pre-tanh raw logit difference u0-u3, not a causal decomposition of nonlinear deployment utility
ordinary_vs_learned_content.computed_method: Elementwise c=(z0-z3)*saved_weights; sum coordinates 17 and 18 for ordinary main effects and sum remaining coordinates separately. Uses saved TRAIN-only feature matrix and weights, without a fit.
ordinary_vs_learned_content.conclusion: The sole admitted corrective pool is clean. Even if it were corrected, its current score contrast is approximately 99.95 percent ordinary candidate AFTER main effects; it would not establish the extra value or necessity of learned attribution.

existing_replay_results_not_new_executio.interpretation: Recorded PRE selection replay preserves the current frozen reference, but no new success or learned attribution benefit was established. Tiny recorded cost differences are not fresh real closed-loop results.
